name: Figarium Research Library
purpose: A personal, human-curated library for finding paper figures and reusing editable resources.

designMethod.note: Used as a design process, not as a brand reference. The requested visual direction explicitly excludes Anthropic's visual identity.

typography.family: Locally hosted Manrope for Latin, PingFang SC or Microsoft YaHei for Chinese
typography.heading: Sans serif; no decorative italic, serif headline, or isolated color-accent word
typography.code: System monospace, only for actual code and paths
typography.body: Readable line height and bounded line length; Chinese-first labels

layout.desktop: [216px navigation | introduction + real featured figure / three resource categories / searchable gallery]
layout.alignment: Left-aligned content; centered figures inside complete white image mounts

principles: The real research figure is the visual focal point, not decorative illustration or large statistics.
Differentiate method figures, result figures, and tables with labels, icons, and semantic colors.
Keep scientific images complete with object-fit: contain; never crop axes, legends, or labels.
Method details expose one figure-specific PPT download, without diagram code or a duplicated paper bundle.
Preserve human selection, provenance, approximation disclosures, and local ownership.
Keep keyboard focus visible and honor reduced-motion preferences.
No warm cream/clay palette, serif editorial treatment, gradients, or decorative motion.
